captions.detailed: A modern household blender featuring a matte black tapered base, a transparent cylindrical jar with a black handle, and a flat black lid. Inside the jar, a metallic six-blade assembly is mounted at the bottom. The front of the base features a circular control dial with a red indicator mark, and the blade assembly is designed to rotate freely on a continuous revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a high-performance household blender. The model should feature a tapered black base with a front control knob, a transparent cylindrical jar with an attached handle, and a top lid. Inside the jar, include a six-blade assembly configured with a continuous revolute joint to allow full rotation.
captions.factory: Construct the blender base by lofting or extruding a tapered square-like profile and adding a cylindrical dial on the front face. Model the jar as a hollow cylinder with glass-like transparency, attaching a curved handle constructed from swept or joined box primitives. Define the blade assembly using thin, angled boxes or extruded profiles arranged radially, and mount it inside the jar base using a continuous revolute joint along the Z-axis.
